alcohol.guidance: No alcohol-risk variants typed — standard moderation applies (≤1-2 drinks/day for men, ≤1 for women).

antioxidants.guidance: Standard endogenous antioxidant capacity — a normal varied diet suffices. Aim for diverse plant colors weekly.

b12.guidance: Variants in B12 transport/secretor status — prioritize high-bioavailable B12 sources: clams, beef liver, sardines, eggs, dairy. Consider 500 µg methylcobalamin sublingual 2–3×/week if vegetarian/vegan.

caffeine.guidance: Slow metaboliser — caffeine half-life prolonged (8+ h). Cap at 200 mg/day (≈ 1 large coffee) and avoid after lunch. Higher dose links to elevated CV risk in slow metabolisers. L-Theanine 100-200 mg paired with caffeine smooths anxiety response.

caloric.guidance: Compute TDEE from formula. For fat loss: subtract 400–500 kcal (smaller deficit if appetite-elevated genotype — sustainability beats speed). For lean gain: +250 kcal with strength training. Protein floor regardless of goal: 1.6–2.0 g/kg body weight, distributed across 3–4 meals.
caloric.tdee_formula: Mifflin-St Jeor: BMR(♂) = 10·kg + 6.25·cm − 5·age + 5; (♀) −161. TDEE = BMR × activity (1.4 sedentary, 1.55 moderate, 1.75 active, 1.9 athlete).

axes.leverage: LDL stays low even on higher-sat-fat diets — Mediterranean fine, dairy OK.
TG handling robust — moderate refined carbs tolerated.
Robust glucose tolerance — standard carb intake fine.

choline.guidance: Adequate intake target 425 mg/day (women) / 550 mg/day (men). 1–2 whole eggs daily covers most.

factors: Elevated appetite — fiber is the most powerful free satiety lever.
Salt-sensitive — potassium-rich high-fiber foods (legumes, potato) double-up benefit.
fiber.guidance: Target 40 g fiber/day — most adults eat 15. Practical: 1 cup oats (8 g), 1 cup berries (8 g), 1 cup beans/lentils (15 g), 2 cups veg (10 g), 1 oz chia/flax (10 g). Ramp up 5 g/week to avoid GI distress; pair with water increase.

gluten.guidance: No DQ2/DQ8 risk haplotype typed/detected — celiac disease is essentially ruled out. Gluten avoidance unnecessary for autoimmune reasons.

glycemic_threshold.guidance: Personal carb ceiling: ~65 g/meal at breakfast/lunch, ~50 g at dinner (circadian glucose tolerance drops PM). Reference portions: 1 cup cooked rice ≈ 45 g, 1 medium banana ≈ 27 g, 1 slice bread ≈ 15 g, 1 cup oats ≈ 27 g, 1 medium potato ≈ 37 g, 1 cup berries ≈ 14 g. Pairing with 25-30 g protein + 10 g fiber + healthy fat blunts glucose excursion 30-50%.

histamine.guidance: Normal histamine clearance — fermented and aged foods well tolerated; they contribute meaningfully to gut-microbiome diversity.

hydration.guidance: Baseline: 30–35 mL/kg body weight daily, +500–750 mL per hour exercise. Salt-sensitive: pre-load 500 mL water on waking; emphasize potassium-rich fluids (coconut water, broth) over electrolyte powders.

inflammation.guidance: Mediterranean pattern with 2× weekly fish, daily berries + nuts, 1 tsp turmeric, minimize processed foods.

iron.guidance: Single H63D copy — minimal clinical risk; no action needed.

lactose.guidance: Lactase non-persistence — symptomatic lactose intolerance likely. Choose lactose-free milk, aged cheeses (parmesan, cheddar), fermented dairy (yoghurt, kefir) which are partially pre-digested. Plant milks for liquid dairy.

macro_periodisation.guidance: Cycling carbs by training load improves body composition and insulin sensitivity vs flat macros. Elevated-appetite genotype: limit carb cycling depth — large --day swings can trigger evening cravings.

rest_day.carb_timing: Lower-carb day — emphasize protein, vegetables, healthy fats. Useful for insulin sensitivity restoration.

training_day.carb_timing: 60% of carbs in pre+post-workout window (65 g pre-session 60 min before, refill within 2 h post). Remaining 40% spread across other meals.

factors: rs9939609 (FTO) AT — better response to lower-carb diet
rs7903146 (TCF7L2) CT — reduced glucose tolerance; minimize refined carbs
APOE ε4 carrier — lower saturated fat, prefer mono/poly
rs174547 (FADS1) TC — favor direct EPA/DHA from fish, not ALA
macros.rationale: Lower-carb skew (~30%) — your variants reduce glucose tolerance.

meal_timing.guidance: Evening chronotype — push first meal later, but cap last meal ≤20:00 to preserve overnight fast.

methylation.guidance: Emphasize folate-rich foods: leafy greens (spinach, kale, romaine), liver, lentils, asparagus, broccoli. Avoid synthetic folic-acid fortified products (many cereals, breads) — they compete with active folate. Choose methylfolate-supplemented options if available.

omega3.guidance: Reduced-activity FADS desaturase variant — ALA from flax/chia/walnut converts inefficiently (<5%) to EPA/DHA. Hit 1.5–2 g combined EPA+DHA daily from oily fish (salmon, sardines, mackerel, herring) 3–4×/week, or algal-/fish-oil supplementation. Vegetarians: algae-oil 500–1000 mg EPA+DHA daily.

practical: Default to steam, sous-vide, slow-cook, and lower-temp roasting.
Marinade meats 30+ min in acid (lemon, vinegar, yoghurt) before any dry heat.
Pair high-AGE meals with high-polyphenol foods (berries, herbs, tea).
Use a thermometer — most home ovens overshoot by 15-20 °C.
cooking_methods.rationale: Advanced glycation end-products (AGEs) form when proteins/fats are exposed to dry, high heat. They accelerate vascular aging and oxidative stress. Same food, different method, can differ 10-100× in AGE load.

rules.use_for: Tough cuts (chuck, shank), legumes, root vegetables
Vegetables + tofu; use a smoke-point-stable oil (avocado, refined olive)
Marinade (acid + olive oil) cuts AGE formation 30-50%
Use sparingly; never char meat. Pair with antioxidant veg/herbs.
Avoid. If used: trim charred bits, marinate in lemon/vinegar/garlic ≥30 min first.

cycle_phase.RED_S_screening: Relative Energy Deficiency in Sport — if cycle becomes irregular or absent while training hard, ENERGY AVAILABILITY is likely too low. Target >40 kcal/kg lean mass/day. Long-term bone density, immunity, performance all suffer. This is a red-flag medical issue, not a body-comp 'win'.

polyphenols.guidance: Polyphenol target: 1500 mg/day. Mixing diverse sources beats single-source mega-dosing. Daily template: 1 cup berries (380), 8 oz coffee (350), 2 tbsp olive oil (180), 1 cup green tea (200), 1 apple (110), 1 oz dark chocolate (250). Total ≈1500 mg. Polyphenols cluster: anthocyanins (berries) + flavanols (cocoa, tea) + hydroxytyrosols (olive) + lignans (flax, sesame) + curcuminoids (turmeric) = broad signaling. Reduced antioxidant capacity flagged — double down on diversity.

travel_jetlag.header: 5-step protocol to compress jet-lag adjustment from 1 day/timezone to ~half.

steps.action: Begin shifting meal times 1 h/day toward destination. East travel: earlier; west: later. Hydrate aggressively. Stop caffeine 8 h before intended sleep window.

Set watch to destination time immediately. Eat ONLY at destination meal times — even if not hungry, force a small protein-fat meal. Skip the in-flight cocktail (alcohol worsens circadian disruption). 240-360 mL water per hour.
First destination-morning meal: heavy protein (30 g) + caffeine + 10-15 min sunlight exposure. Anchors cortisol awakening response to new time zone.

Carb-leaning dinner finished by 19:00 local. Tryptophan-rich (turkey, salmon, pumpkin seeds) + complex carbs to spike serotonin → melatonin conversion. Melatonin 0.3-0.5 mg 4 h before intended sleep — micro-dose, not the 3-5 mg sold OTC (too much sedates without phase-shifting).
Maintain destination meal timing strictly. Don't nap >20 min before 14:00 local. Daily morning sunlight 15 min. Caffeine cutoff 8 h before intended bedtime.

supplements_considered: Melatonin 0.3 mg micro-dose 4 h before bed at destination
L-theanine 200 mg with caffeine for smoother wake-up
Electrolyte mix on flight — dehydration amplifies jet-lag fatigue

factors: rs699 (AGT M235T) AG — salt-sensitive hypertension allele
salt.guidance: Reduce sodium to ≤2.3 g/day; emphasize potassium-rich foods (leafy greens, beans, potato). DASH-style pattern especially beneficial.

satiety.guidance: High-satiety eating pattern is critical. Anchor every meal with: (1) 30–40 g protein (eggs, Greek yoghurt, fish, lean meat, tofu), (2) 8–10 g fiber (legumes, berries, vegetables), (3) volume from non-starchy veg. Front-load calories to breakfast/lunch; keep dinner lighter. Avoid liquid calories (juice, smoothies as meals — they bypass satiety). Pre-meal water 500 mL + salad reduces total intake. 12-hour overnight fast helps; longer (16:8) only if it doesn't trigger evening binges.

saturated_fat.guidance: APOE ε4 carrier — markedly elevated LDL response to saturated fat. Cap saturated fat at ≤15 g/day (~7% of calories). Replace butter/coconut oil with extra-virgin olive oil and avocado; limit red meat to 1–2×/week, choose poultry/fish. Prioritize MUFA (olive, avocado, almonds) and PUFA (walnuts, fatty fish). Mediterranean pattern is best-evidence.

taste.fat_guidance: Normal fat-taste — internal satiety cues for high-fat foods are reliable.

vitamin_a.guidance: Normal β-carotene conversion — colorful plant sources (sweet potato, carrot, kale, pumpkin) cover retinol needs.

vitamin_c.guidance: Standard 90 mg/day (men)/75 mg (women) from varied produce.

vitamin_d_food.guidance: Prioritize high-D foods: wild salmon, sardines, herring, egg yolks, UV-treated mushrooms, fortified dairy. Combine with daytime sun exposure where possible (10-30 min, depending on skin tone, latitude, season).

vitamin_e.guidance: Standard vitamin-E from nuts/seeds/oils. Supplementation usually unnecessary.
